title: Stones That Outlasted Their Builders
description:
Ruins are signs that someone—or something—was here before you. Most are safe enough to investigate cautiously; a few are warnings.

This is an optional vanilla-ID detection pilot. Modded ruins are not silently treated as vanilla structures, and the quest does not gate major progress.

Field note: Do not assume every tower is safe. Look for mobs, traps or an obvious entrance before rushing inside.

objectives.name: Enter a known vanilla ruin or landmark
